caption: The drawing depicts a carved, painted figure of a jockey riding a leaping horse. The horse is a pale cream or off-white color with visible surface cracks, black hooves, a black bridle, and a large black eye. The horse’s body is elongated in a horizontal leaping pose with its legs stretched forward and backward, and the number “20” is painted in black on its side. The jockey wears a yellow helmet with a red peak, a green long-sleeve top, dark pants, and tall black boots. The hands grip reins that are painted as a single black line. There is a vertical cylindrical support beneath the horse’s body, giving the appearance that the figure could be part of a carousel or similar ride. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects or details present.
title: Horse and Jockey
